title: Navy-CIA tug-of-war over the NURO
summary: UAPGerb tells of Navy-CIA tug-of-war over the NURO, about 1969-1972 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: up until 1972 there was a huge tugof-war between the Navy and CIA specifically the DS&T over u who controls the neuro

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that from 1969 until 1972 there was a big fight between the US Navy and the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, specifically its science and technology branch, over who would control the NURO, a secret office for underwater spying. He cites a man named Bobby Rayanman for this and tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, as a sign of how much the agencies cared about that office.
